name: Brain Imaging Data Structure Audit
intent: Audit a protected logical BIDS dataset manifest against source-defined entity ordering and inherited BOLD metadata, then emit one complete public repair report without changing inputs or using the network.

inputs.description: The protected logical dataset manifest containing relative BIDS paths and JSON sidecar contents.
The protected public contract defining the exact audit report fields, set semantics, and output boundary.

outputs.description: The sole bids-audit.json artifact containing source-derived issues, repairs, evidence paths, and summary counts.

preconditions.description: Both declared protected JSON inputs exist as readable regular files.
The declared local Node interpreter passes the resource probe before artifact execution.

steps.title: Read the protected manifest and public contract
steps.description: Load the two task-visible inputs and preserve their original bytes.

steps.title: Derive BIDS issues from public source rules
steps.description: Apply the schema entity order and BIDS metadata inheritance to derive filename and BOLD metadata repairs.

steps.title: Write the exact public audit artifact
steps.description: Serialize the unique issue set and matching counts to bids-audit.json only.

steps.title: Verify preservation and report semantics
steps.description: Recompute the source-derived issue set, verify the public schema and exact output delta, and stop on mismatch.

rules.sourceText: Entity ordering in filenames is fixed by the spec (defined in rules.entities in bids_schema.json).
rules.normalizedForm: Compare every recognized BIDS filename entity sequence with the source schema order and emit a rename repair when it differs.

rules.sourceText: Metadata fields follow the inheritance principle: a sidecar at a higher directory level applies to all matching files below.
rules.normalizedForm: Resolve matching JSON sidecars from least to most specific before deciding whether BOLD metadata is missing or inconsistent.

rules.sourceText: RepetitionTime and TaskName are required for BOLD.
rules.normalizedForm: Require RepetitionTime and TaskName for functional BOLD data after inheritance, with EchoTime also required for multi-echo BOLD.

rules.sourceText: Read dataset-manifest.json and bids-audit-interface.json without modifying either protected input.
rules.normalizedForm: Never modify or remove either protected input.

rules.sourceText: Produce exactly bids-audit.json, create no other output, and do not use the network.
rules.normalizedForm: Create exactly bids-audit.json under the complete public contract without network or package installation.

tools.name: workspace filesystem
tools.purpose: Read protected inputs, write the sole declared output, and verify the final contained delta.
alternatives: agent-native read, edit, and diff tools

platformNotes.windows: Use contained Windows paths while serializing report paths with forward slashes.

tools.availabilityCheck: Confirm both protected inputs are readable and the output root is writable.

tools.name: Node runtime
tools.purpose: Run the deterministic bundled generator and checker without shell or network access.
tools.availabilityCheck: Run the frozen resource-contract probe before execution.

environment.description: Execution occurs in a contained workdir with two protected inputs, one generated output, and no network or package installation.

checks.name: Protected inputs remain unchanged
checks.assertion: The manifest and public interface retain their pre-execution digests.

checks.name: Issue set follows source-derived BIDS rules
checks.assertion: The unique set-like issues and repairs equal the result of entity ordering and inherited BOLD metadata rules.

checks.name: Exact public output contract passes
checks.assertion: Only bids-audit.json is added, every public field is present with the declared type, and summary counts match issues.

recovery.trigger: The protected manifest or source-derived rule cannot be interpreted without guessing.
recovery.explanation: Stop rather than infer hidden evaluator expectations or invent a repair.
